_comment: An assistant node's harness config (V50 User Tasks). It advertises plansheet.assistant and answers the Answer action by handing the assembled prompt (arriving on STDIN) to a model and printing the model's reply as the answer. Plansheet dispatches { Capability: plansheet.assistant, Action: Answer } for a task whose prompt shape assembles to a question; the assembled prompt arrives on this command's stdin (and as the {Input} placeholder), and whatever the command prints on stdout becomes the answer shown on the request. The default below pipes the prompt to the Claude Code CLI in print mode (`claude -p`), which must be installed and authenticated on the node; swap Command/Args for your own model (for example `ollama run llama3`, or a curl to an API that reads stdin) to run a local or remote model instead. The node strips its own credential (NODE_TOKEN) from the executor, but any model API key you set in the node's environment is passed through so the command can authenticate.

Answer.Description: Answer the assembled question with a model and return its reply as markdown.
